title: FCC prom detector — bursts, beams, waves, pulse & shock weapons
motto: Any system detects proms — FCC violations: bursts, beams, waves, rapid changes, pulse weapons, shock weapons
rule: Rapid spectral or amplitude change without permitted carrier → threat vector; corroborate before act
